## VS Code Keyboard Shortcuts

| Open file | Ctrl+O | Cmd+O |

| Quick open (find file) | Ctrl+P | Cmd+P |
| Go to line | Ctrl+G | Ctrl+G |
| Close file | Ctrl+W | Cmd+W |
| Close all files | Ctrl+K Ctrl+W | Cmd+K Cmd+W |

## SSH and Remote Connection

### Initial Setup
```bash
# Create SSH config file
~/.ssh/config

# Add entry:
Host sagehen
    HostName sagehen.hpc.pomona.edu
    User username
    ServerAliveInterval 300
    ServerAliveCountMax 2

# Set permissions
chmod 600 ~/.ssh/config
chmod 700 ~/.ssh

# Test connection
ssh sagehen
```

### Generate SSH Keys (Optional)
```bash
# Create new key
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "your-email@pomona.edu"

# Copy public key to cluster
ssh-copy-id -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 sagehen

# Now login without password (DUO still required):
ssh sagehen
```

### VS Code Remote Settings
**Enable `remote.SSH.showLoginTerminal` in settings** (critical for DUO!)

## SLURM Commands for HPC

### Job Submission
```bash
# Submit a job script
sbatch job_script.sh

# Submit with options
sbatch --job-name=myjob --time=01:00:00 script.sh

# Submit and get job ID
JOBID=$(sbatch script.sh | awk '{print $4}')
```

### Monitor Jobs
```bash
# View all your jobs
squeue -u username

# View specific job
squeue -j 12345

# Watch jobs update (refreshes every 2 seconds)
watch squeue -u username

# View completed jobs
sacct -u username --format=jobid,jobname,state,elapsed

# Get job efficiency (CPU, memory usage)
seff 12345
```

### Manage Jobs
```bash
# Cancel job
scancel 12345

# Cancel all your jobs
scancel -u username

# Pause job (hold)
scontrol hold 12345

# Resume job (release)
scontrol release 12345
```

### Cluster Information
```bash
# View available resources
sinfo

# View node status
sinfo -N

# View partitions
sinfo -p

# Get your account info
sacctmgr show user username
```

### Job Script Template
```bash
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=analysis
#SBATCH --output=logs/job_%j.log
#SBATCH --error=logs/job_%j.err
#SBATCH --time=01:00:00
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=4
#SBATCH --mem=8G
#SBATCH --partition=amd

# Your commands here
module load miniconda3
python my_script.py --input data.csv --output results.csv
```

## File Management

### Directory Navigation (Terminal)
```bash
# Change directory
cd /path/to/folder
cd ~                    # Home directory
cd ..                   # Parent directory
cd -                    # Previous directory

# List files
ls                      # Simple listing
ls -l                   # Detailed listing
ls -lh                  # Human-readable sizes
ls -la                  # Include hidden files

# Show current directory
pwd

# Create directory
mkdir newfolder

# Copy file
cp source.txt destination.txt

# Move/rename file
mv oldname.txt newname.txt

# Delete file (careful!)
rm filename.txt

# View file content
cat filename.txt
head -n 20 filename.txt
tail -n 20 filename.txt
```

### File Paths on Sagehen
```bash
# Home directory
/rhome/<myusername>

# Scratch space (temporary, fast)
/scratch/username

# Project directories
/rhome/<myusername>/projects

# System directories
/usr/bin             # System programs
/opt                 # Optional software
/home                # User home dirs (different from /rhome)
```

## Common SLURM Directives

| Directive | Purpose | Example |
|-----------|---------|---------|
| `--job-name` | Job name (visible in queue) | `--job-name=analysis` |
| `--time` | Max runtime (HH:MM:SS) | `--time=01:00:00` |
| `--cpus-per-task` | CPU cores | `--cpus-per-task=4` |
| `--mem` | Memory per node | `--mem=8G` |
| `--mem-per-cpu` | Memory per CPU | `--mem-per-cpu=2G` |
| `--partition` | Queue/partition | `--partition=amd` |
| `--output` | stdout file | `--output=logs/job.log` |
| `--error` | stderr file | `--error=logs/job.err` |
| `--mail-type` | When to email | `--mail-type=END,FAIL` |
| `--mail-user` | Email address | `--mail-user=you@pomona.edu` |
| `--nodes` | Number of nodes | `--nodes=2` |
| `--tasks-per-node` | Tasks per node | `--tasks-per-node=1` |
| `--array` | Job array | `--array=1-10` |

## Troubleshooting

### Connection Issues

**Error: "Could not establish connection"**
- Check SSH works from terminal: `ssh sagehen`
- Verify hostname and username in ~/.ssh/config
- Ensure DUO is registered and phone has app
- Check firewall isn't blocking SSH (port 22)

**Error: "Authentication failed"**
- Verify password is correct
- Check caps lock
- Ensure DUO code isn't expired (codes last 30 seconds)
- Try requesting call instead of code

**Error: "Permission denied (publickey)"**
- SSH key problem
- Check key exists and has correct permissions: `ls -la ~/.ssh/`
- Try password authentication instead
- Contact HPC team if key is corrupted

**VS Code hangs during authentication**
- Check `remote.SSH.showLoginTerminal` is enabled in settings
- Disconnect and try again
- Restart VS Code
- Try from terminal first: `ssh sagehen`

### File Issues

**Error: "Permission denied" editing file**
- File may be read-only
- Check permissions: `ls -l filename`
- Make writable: `chmod u+w filename`
- Or copy to new file you own

**Error: "File too large to edit"**
- VS Code may struggle with huge files (>100 MB)
- Use terminal tools instead: `cat`, `less`, `grep`
- Or edit in smaller chunks

### Extension Issues

**Extension not working after install**
- Reload VS Code: Cmd+Shift+P → "Reload Window"
- Check it's installed in right location (remote vs. local)
- Uninstall and reinstall

**Extensions slow down VS Code**
- Check number of installed extensions
- Disable unused ones
- Restart VS Code
- Check task manager for high CPU

## Terminal Useful Commands

```bash
# Environment
module avail          # See available modules
module load miniconda3  # Load Python (via conda)
python --version     # Check Python version

# Process management
ps aux                # See running processes
top                   # Monitor processes (press q to exit)
kill -9 PID           # Kill process by ID

# Disk usage
du -sh /rhome/<myusername>    # Check home directory size
df -h                     # Check available disk space
quota                     # Check your quota

# File compression
tar -czf archive.tar.gz folder/    # Create gzip archive
tar -xzf archive.tar.gz            # Extract archive
zip -r archive.zip folder/         # Create zip
unzip archive.zip                  # Extract zip

# Text processing
grep "pattern" file.txt           # Find lines matching pattern
sed 's/old/new/g' file.txt        # Replace text
awk '{print $1}' file.txt         # Extract columns
cut -d',' -f1 file.csv            # Get first CSV column

# Network
ping sagehen.hpc.pomona.edu       # Test connection
curl http://example.com           # Download file
wget http://example.com/file.txt  # Download with wget
```

<script>(function(){var CSS='.sh-placeholder{color:#c2410c;font-weight:700}[data-bs-theme="dark"] .sh-placeholder,html.dark .sh-placeholder{color:#fdba74}@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){[data-bs-theme="auto"] .sh-placeholder{color:#fdba74}}';var RX=/<labname>|<myusername>/g;function firstMatch(el){var w=document.createTreeWalker(el,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT,null),nodes=[],full='';while(w.nextNode()){nodes.push({n:w.currentNode,s:full.length});full+=w.currentNode.nodeValue;}RX.lastIndex=0;var m;while((m=RX.exec(full))){var s=m.index,e=s+m[0].length,inSpan=false,parts=[];for(var j=0;j<nodes.length;j++){var ns=nodes[j].s,ne=ns+nodes[j].n.nodeValue.length;if(ne<=s||ns>=e)continue;parts.push({node:nodes[j].n,a:Math.max(s-ns,0),b:Math.min(e-ns,nodes[j].n.nodeValue.length)});var p=nodes[j].n.parentNode;while(p&&p!==el){if(p.classList&&p.classList.contains('sh-placeholder')){inSpan=true;break;}p=p.parentNode;}}if(!inSpan&&parts.length)return parts;}return null;}function wrapParts(parts){for(var i=parts.length-1;i>=0;i--){var t=parts[i].node,txt=t.nodeValue,a=parts[i].a,b=parts[i].b;var span=document.createElement('span');span.className='sh-placeholder';span.textContent=txt.slice(a,b);var f=document.createDocumentFragment();if(a>0)f.appendChild(document.createTextNode(txt.slice(0,a)));f.appendChild(span);if(b<txt.length)f.appendChild(document.createTextNode(txt.slice(b)));t.parentNode.replaceChild(f,t);}}function run(){var st=document.createElement('style');st.textContent=CSS;document.head.appendChild(st);document.querySelectorAll('pre,code').forEach(function(el){var guard=0,parts;while((parts=firstMatch(el))&&guard++<500){wrapParts(parts);}});}if(document.readyState==='loading'){document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',run);}else{run();}})();</script>
